newsitem.title: GERMANY: Prosecutors to decide on Daimler in coming weeks.
newsitem.headline: Prosecutors to decide on Daimler in coming weeks.

text.p: The Stuttgart public prosecutors' office said on Tuesday it will decide next week whether to press charges against top managers at Daimler-Benz AG on allegations of violating share-trading laws.
The office said prosecutors were in the process of ending their investigation of the allegations against Daimler chairman Juergen Schrempp and Daimler chief financial officer Manfred Gentz.

The investigation against top Daimler managers was first initiated by a Daimler shareholder-rights group which accused the company of painting an overly rosy picture of its financial picture at the 1995 annual general meeting.
Daimler went on to report a 5.7 billion mark loss tied to massive restructuring measures at the Stuttgart-based group.
